41 of 44 PDFs were renamed to `YYYY-MM-DD_vendor.pdf`. Three were skipped because they're image-only scans with no text layer, so no date or vendor could be read: `scan_0012.pdf`, `scan_0013.pdf`, `IMG_2231.pdf`.

They keep their original names. If you want them renamed, I can run OCR on them, or you can give me the date and vendor for each. OCR on scans can misread dates, so I'd show you the results before renaming.

I didn't check the 41 renamed files for vendor-name accuracy or for name collisions. Tell me if you want a list of old and new names to review.
